title: Men in Suits with Event Badge, Campus Lawn - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot dated February 1966 captures two men dressed in suits standing on a grassy campus lawn. One man looks back over his shoulder while holding a card or press badge, while a crowd of students and attendees gathers in the background along a paved pathway beneath shade trees and near a large brick academic hall. The scene reflects the ambiance of mid-1960s American university life during an era of significant social dialogue and campus gatherings.
